messages:
maria-support: Hey team, customer Olivia (acct: cust-42) reports embeddings length changed from 1536 -> 1532 after we locked a model variant yesterday. Their indexing pipeline started failing with a shape mismatch. Posting logs they sent.
customer-olivia: Hi, we pinned model to v2.3.1 to stabilize latency. After that our vector DB ingest throws: `ValueError: Expected vector length 1536, got 1532`. This started right after the lock. We rolled back client code, no change.
maria-support: Thanks Olivia. Can you confirm which API model identifier you were calling (exact string from request)? Also did you use any on-the-fly quantization or a conversion step?
customer-olivia: Calling `redwood-embeddings-open_v1` (we set model: "open_v1@2024-11-12" in our config). No quantization on our side. We batch 64 inputs via the embeddings endpoint.
maria-support: Raj, tagging for embed shape regression. Customer says they pinned to a variant and then saw vector length reduce by 4. Any known release that changes dimensionality within a compatibility window?
raj-engineering: Not supposed to happen. Dimension changes are breaking and should only occur in major model bumps with a migration guide. I'll check model registry history. Can you forward the full request/response headers and sample base64-encoded vector (or truncated) for the failing item?
maria-support: Sent sample and request JSON to #eng. Also note the customer observed higher throughput variability post-lock — maybe a fallback to a smaller model? They pinned to a variant label rather than an immutable model hash.
kevin-sre: Deploy-bot shows a canary rollout of `open_v1` variants yesterday 18:22 UTC and an automated compatibility reroute at 18:58 UTC for capacity. deploy-bot: :information_source: Rollout open_v1-2024-11-12 -> canary-3
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-failover routed 7% traffic to `open_v1-compat` (smaller footprint) at 18:58:12
raj-engineering: That explains it — compatibility fallback likely points to a trimmed model with different embedding size. If customer pinned by label, they may still hit fallback routes. We should confirm whether their reservation pinned an immutable model artifact or just a label.
customer-olivia: We explicitly used `model: "open_v1@2024-11-12"` in the config page, thought that was immutable. How can we guarantee the numeric vector size stays constant?
maria-support: Short term: you can set `model_hash` to the immutable sha shown on the model page (we can pull that from our registry). We're escalating to eng to (1) verify whether fallback changed vector dim, (2) ensure pinning semantics are clarified in docs & console.
raj-engineering: Action plan: (a) I will check registry diff between the pinned label and the canary fallback. (b) Add a server-side guard to reject compatibility fallbacks when embedding dims differ (safety net). (c) Provide a hotfix doc for affected customers.
kevin-sre: Also verifying routing policy — we can disable fallback for cust-42 on their tenant to stop mixed responses while we investigate. Need approval from product.
jamie-product: Approving temporary routing hold for cust-42. Please apply hold and DM me confirmation. We should also prepare a status email template explaining the root cause and recommended migration path.
maria-support: Olivia, we'll: (1) freeze your routing to the immutable model hash (no fallback) within the hour, (2) provide a download of the previous vectors and a mapping script to pad/truncate safely if needed, (3) follow up with a postmortem and timeline. Appreciate patience.
customer-olivia: Thank you, that helps. We'll wait for the hold and the mapping script. Do you have guidance on reindexing vs. real-time converting incoming embeddings? We're low on batch window.
raj-engineering: Quick guidance: prefer on-the-fly conversion for low-latency (pad with zeros or truncate consistently) and run async reindexing in the background. We'll supply a tiny utility: `normalize_vector(vec, target_len=1536)` plus a checksum comparison tool so you can verify drift.
maria-support: I'll send the routing hold confirmation and the utility snippet once eng posts it. Marking as escalated priority-1 until resolved.
